config.purpose: Measure usable semantic-repair supervision in the already selected 16-log training pool, before designing another training intervention. Do not repeat the old six-log audit or add architecture.
config.selection: Exactly the original instance-memory-20261029 train partition: 16 collection logs / 642 frames, selected before this audit. No development or new holdout inference.
config.models: Frozen existing seed-0 current-only anchor and current-anchored-repair-v2 temporal head. Current loader uses fully disabled PTv3 serialization shuffling. These older heads were trained with the legacy pooling policy: this is a declared feature-policy/coverage diagnostic, not a new generalization or deployment result.
config.controls: Same backbone forward, same frozen anchor, same repair weights; normal temporal and same-head current-token output. Traced temporal core must match the uninstrumented temporal core on all logits/query indices and raw memory state for every frame.
config.supervision: GT enters only the observer. Report query coverage, anchor errors with a correct predicted historical class, stricter correct same-instance (or same-stuff-class) evidence, preservation conflicts, and unique physical instances. Compute class-weighted loss mass for the existing repair objective without backpropagation; it is not a gradient attribution or proof of optimization failure.
config.objects: GT panoptic IDs, at least 5 valid points per current/previous object observation, at least half correct means success. Opportunity: current anchor or same-head no-history fails and immediately previous raw B0 succeeds for the same ID within 0.75 s. Panoptic grouping differs from the old box-based audit; counts are not a direct before/after improvement.
config.implementation: Retain the original query selection, 4096 budget, radii, cosine gate, raw-memory writes, residual bound and network. No training, threshold search, saved full feature cache, model download, or remote job.
config.followup: Use the observed failure stage to specify a supervised test with matched current-only controls. Any later retrained anchor changes the queries and requires measuring its own coverage. Audit success never grants deployment admission.
